faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Deputy Project Manager post at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Deputy Project Manager position at IIT Kanpur is 12th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Deputy Project Manager role?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Deputy Project Manager position at IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Deputy Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a CA/ICWA/CS degree, or a Post Graduate degree with 5 years of relevant experience, or a Graduate degree with 8 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. However, age relaxation up to 50 years is provided for IIT Kanpur project employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Deputy Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 23000-2000-59000 /- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the official notification, no application fee is mentioned for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Deputy Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IIT Kanpur Deputy Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the Google Form link provided in the Important Links section or via the official IIT Kanpur website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Deputy Project Manager position at IIT Kanpur is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the Important Links section of this article for your reference.
